en: Maybe it did...
Hey, do you still have that ring?

I'd like to buy it...
It's... a very important ring.
Huh!? Wait, wait, what!?

I have exactly the ring you're looking for.
But I can't accept just any payment.

I'll need y'to give me half of everything y'own...
What do you say? Let's start over?

Honey...
Yes! I want to spend my life with you!

This is next-level cheese... I couldn't spit
a line like that if my life depended on it.

Women love this sappy drama stuff.
Look, even Mama's cryin'.
Ah... It's so good... So good!
Heh. Adversity's a good thing sometimes.

Whew! The purse snatcher was handed over to the
police and Ando-san got the girl. Case closed.

Thanks so much, all of you. I caused a lotta
worry and y'helped me more than you know.

I want to thank everyone too. Please
keep taking care of Ando... My husband.

Well then, this calls for some
drinks to celebrate.

Oh, good call!
Kiryu-san, you should come too!
Why don't we toss Ando-san in the air?
You'll break my bar, so no.
She's got ya there.

Yo, Ando-san. 
Things going okay with your wife?

Yeah, thankfully. 
It doesn't feel very new, though.
Hm, I see.

So Kiryu-san, I heard you were the one
who took down the purse snatcher.
Yeah, I did. What about it?

Nah, it's just my wife won't shut up
about how cool you were that day.

I know women are more drawn to a strong
man... So I got a favor t'ask, Kiryu-san.
A favor?

I heard a rumor that you've assembled a
team to fight for the city. Is that true?

Can I join your group? I want to be
strong enough to protect my family.

Fighting is easier said than done.
Are you ready for a real fight?

Yeah, this city means the world t'me.
I'm ready to give it all for this place.

Okay, then I'll just say I look forward
to fighting by your side, Ando-san!
Yeah! Same here, Kiryu-san!

Hm? Isn't that Kaneko-san?
What's he up to?

Yo, Kaneko-san.
What're you doing?
W-Whoa!
Wh-What's wrong?

K-Kiryu-san...
Just now... You saw that?

See what?
You mean how you were shadowboxing?

C-Can you keep that on the down low?
The guys at the bar will make fun of me...

Your secret's safe with me.
No worries.

R-Right, sorry... I'm about to head to the bar.
Wanna come with, Kiryu-san?
Think I could buy you a drink?

(Kaneko-san's desperate...
He really didn't want to be seen, I guess.)
Let's see...
Nice nice, let's go.
Sorry, I'm a bit busy right now.

Oh, okay... Well, I'll be at the bar
so come over when you can.

Hm, I recall Kaneko-san saying he'll
be at the bar. Maybe I should drop by?
Yeah, I'll go in.
No, I'll go another day.
Yo, I'm back.

Welcome back!
Have a seat.

I feel like that drink got to me. I'm gonna go
sober up and get some fresh air at the shrine.
Sure, see you later.

Um, excuse me... Would y'happen t'know
if there's a guy named Kaneko around here?
Kaneko? Yeah, I was just drinking with him.

Ah! Is that so? 
That mean you're his friend?
Yeah, something like that. You are?

Sorry, where're my manners. Name's Tsunashima,
I'm the boss of Kaneko's old boxing gym.
Kaneko-san used to train at your gym?
Yes, well... Is Kaneko doin' alright?

Yeah, he's all right. 
I hear he works in an office these days.

Oh yeah? I was worried he'd be feeling
down 'bout retiring. Guess I was wrong.

I know it's rude t'ask fer favors from a
stranger, but can y'hear this old man out?

I wantchya t'give this photo to Kaneko
and tell him, "Thank you very much."

Let's just say... 
It was the reason Kaneko stopped boxing.

Reason? You know, I was curious,
why did Kaneko-san stop boxing?
He protected a girl from some punks.
Protected?

A group of thugs had surrounded a
defenseless girl out by herself.
Kaneko had jus' happened to pass by.

He beat 'em to a pulp to protect that girl.
But one of 'em jus' wouldn't let it end...

Turns out one of 'em was the
son of a tabloid editor.

"Pro Boxer Assaults Young Boy"
made national headlines.

No matter the reason, pro boxers can't
go raisin' their hands to civilians...

Kaneko retired quietly, said he didn't
wanna bring trouble to the gym.
So that's what happened...

The girl he saved came by the gym.
She wanted Kaneko to know how grateful she is.

So that's why you're looking for Kaneko-san.
Why don't you give it to him yourself then?

Naw, if he's on a new path in life,
it's better I don't meet with him.
I'd probably dredge up bad memories.

Boxing has a mysterious charm to it.
Once it's got its hook in ya, it becomes yer world.

And if he retired 'fore he felt he was done,
I'm sure that fire is still burnin' deep down.

I don't know what I'd say if our
meeting ignited that fire again.

But I want him to know that the girl he
saved was thankful... Can you do that?

So that's the reason... 
Man, boxers sure are an awkward bunch.

Not that I have any room to talk...
It is what it is. I'll let Kaneko-san know.
Y'will!? Thank you kindly.
Oh yes. About that photo...

Well, I better go see Kaneko-san. 
He said he'd be heading to the shrine.

I should go meet Kaneko-san.
He said he was going to the shrine.

Oh, it's you, Kiryu-san. 
You trying to sober up too?
Yeah, sorta.

Man, thanks to those clowns at the bar,
I can't seem to get my past out of my head.
You mean, back in your boxing days?
Yeah, but all that's behind me now.

I heard you protected a girl by fighting
off a group of lowlifes.

Wha...!? Kiryu-san, who told you that story?
Was it Mama!?

No, it wasn't her. Actually, I ran into the boss
of the boxing gym you used to belong to.
What? He was here?

Yeah, he said he didn't want to bother
you, so he asked me to give you a message.
No way... What was it?

The girl you saved came to visit the gym,
to tell you, "Thank you for helping me."
Oh. I see.

What's the matter?
Did that upset you?
It's just... I don't deserve her thanks...

Deep down, I'll always wonder if I could've
been a boxing champ if I hadn't saved her...
I question whether saving her was right...
What a terrible thing to think, right?

I mean, I'm glad she's safe and all,
but my life... You know?

I have so many regrets about boxing...
I've never been able to give it all up.

I saved her knowing I'd end up having to
retire, but it was pretty damn rough...
I can see where you're coming from.

I often find myself asking, what if I'd
done something differently too...

That said, someone who fights to protect another
can overcome any obstacle. In my opinion, anyway.

And it's not like you instantly know you
did the right thing. It takes time to realize it.
The boss asked me to give it to you.

When you came to that girl's rescue
back then... She was pregnant.
You actually saved two people that day.
That girl... I can't believe it...
Still questioning if it was the right choice?

I get it... And I'm glad...
Seriously...

You giving up boxing wasn't pointless.
You protected something precious.
And you should be proud.

Thanks, Kiryu-san... This is the first
time I've really faced my past.

And I can't let it be my burden anymore.
I'd be a disgrace if I never moved on.
Heh... Sounds like you already have.
But this... What a beautiful photo.
Hey, Kiryu-san!

Yo, Kaneko-san.
You look refreshed.

Ah, yeah?
Well, I couldn't stay depressed forever.
I've decided to live life on my own terms.
Heh, that so?

It is. Also, Kiryu-san, I heard you put together
a team to take on gangs on the streets.
Y-Yeah, I have.

This team of yours... Got room for one more?
I want to protect more people with my fists!

These are no-holds-barred brawls, not like
boxing. Is getting hurt a risk you can live with?
Yeah, all part of the game.

Okay, then. In that case...
Lend me your strength.

Yeah! It's gonna be great to
fight at your side, Kiryu-san!
Please take one!
Oh, here y'go.
Hm? What is this?
A free stationery sample!

We use quality paper to give weight
to your heartfelt feelings.

Write a thank you note to someone
you might owe! How about it?
A thank you letter, huh...

If you like our products, please buy
more at the stationery store!

Hm? No one's here...
Did Mama go out on an errand?
These smalltown bars... Geez.

Gets me thinking though... I've hardly
been here long, yet they feel like family.

Drinking and laughing with them,
hearing out their troubles...
I haven't had that in a really long time.

I owe these people my gratitude
for giving me a place like this.
Wait, gratitude...?

That reminds me, I have this stationery set. 
They said I should express heartfelt feelings...
Hrm... I'm not much of a writer...

But I guess I can try.
The mama here deserves a letter.
I'm sure this letter comes as a bit of a surprise.

I figured some things can't be conveyed 
in spoken words, so I picked up a pen.

I've had a great time ever since
I dropped in here for the first time.

You accepted even an outsider like me with
drinks and songs, and that makes it special.
I find myself staying longer and longer...

And I'm sure the reason this bar feels so
warm is because you've made it that way.

I remember the first time I shared
a drink with you pretty clearly.

And whenever I've felt down,
drinking here cheered me right up.

You've made me realize just how important
it is to have a companion you can count on.

Thank you.
Be who you are and don't ever change.

If you're interested, I'd like to treat you 
to a meal. I'll be waiting at the ferry dock.
All the best.
There... Good to go.

Now, how do I give her the letter?
I can't just hand it to her...

It'd be better if I hid it somewhere in
the bar only Mama could find.

She'll probably clean up a bit when she
gets back, so she'll find it.
Okay, let's find a hiding spot.

I haven't hidden the letter yet.
I've got to hide it before I go.

The new karaoke machine. I'm sure Mama 
would find it pretty easily when she cleans it...
Should I hide the letter here?
Yeah, I'll put it here.
Nah, I'll look around more.

The darts machine is what catches the eye.
This would be a good hiding spot.

This is the table we all use...
It'll be easy to notice if I put it here.

I'm sure anyone could find it
if I left it on the counter.

A baseball poster... It draws the eye to it.
I'll just slip it in behind the poster.

The electric pot...
The guys never seem to use it.

Well... I told her to meet me at the ferry
dock, but I've got some time.
I'll kill some time wandering around a bit.

Mama hasn't read the letter yet. I should wait
a bit more before going to the ferry dock.

Oh, it's about time I meet up with Mama.
I should go to the ferry dock.
Sorry, did I make you wait?
Nah, I just got here myself!

What!? G-Gen-san...!
Why...?
Buddy, y'surprised me.

The bar was empty, so I went to do some
karaoke. That's when I saw your letter.

Oh no... Of course Gen-san would find it
before Mama in the karaoke machine...

Your letter made me happy, Kiryu-san...
I had no idea y'thought the world of me.

Well, you taught me a lot about technology.
So I wanted to show my gratitude somehow...

I ain't so sure I can live up to your
impression of me, but... I'll try my best!
I should probably put a stop to this...

Yeah, so, that's why I'm grateful!
See you at the bar!

Huh, hey, Kiryu-san!? I didn't get to
talk... No need t'be so shy, man...
No... I just got here.

What!? A-Ando-san...!
Why...?
What do you mean, "why?"

The bar was empty, so I went t'play
some darts and I found yer letter.

Oh no... I should have known Ando might
find it by the darts instead of Mama...

But I had no idea that y'thought
so highly of me, Kiryu-san.

Well, you sell me lots of things, so I
wanted to show my gratitude somehow...

I need t'properly repay you for your kind
words. So, please give me some time...
N-No, don't think about it too much.

Wait, Kiryu-san!?
Man, he marches t'his own drum...
No, I just got here, too!

What!? K-Kaneko-san...!
Why...?

What do you mean "why?"
You told me to come.

The bar was quiet so I relaxed on the sofa,
and I found a letter stashed on the table.

Oh no... By putting it on the table,
Kaneko-san found it instead of Mama...
Sorry. I never noticed the way you felt at all.

No... Don't worry about it. You helped me
out so I just wanted to show some thanks...

I may not be much more than a boxer,
but I can handle your feelings, Kiryu-san!
(What the hell is he on about...?)

H-Hey, Kiryu-san!? What the heck?
I was all fired up and everything...
No, I just showed up!

What?! H-Hatakeyama-san...!
Why...?

Whaddaya mean, Kiryu-san?
Y'told me to show up here.
